content.short: Ton Launchpad is a comprehensive platform for fundraising, marketing, and token management on TON.
content.description: Ton Launchpad is a professional-grade fundraising and project incubation platform built specifically for the TON blockchain. It provides developers with a full suite of decentralized tools, including token minting, automated airdrops, and liquidity lockers, to ensure a secure and successful project launch. For investors, Ton Launchpad offers early access to vetted projects through a transparent IDO process. By consolidating these essential services, it serves as a critical infrastructure piece for the growth and professionalization of the TON ecosystem.
content.meta: Launch or invest in new TON projects with Ton Launchpad. Secure Web3 fundraising on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
